title: settled: chain
description: Six questions about the devnet on one screen; the details under them, closed until needed.

panels.title: L2 makes blocks
panels.description: Green: the sequencer makes about 30 blocks a minute (one every 2 s). Red: fewer than 25. If red, open Details: L2.

panels.title: Batches reach the L1
panels.description: How much of the L2 the L1 has not confirmed yet: the unsafe head minus the safe head, at 2 s a block. Green: less than 3 minutes; normally under one, as a batch goes out every 30 s. Red: batches are not reaching the L1. If red, open Details: batcher.

panels.title: Verifier keeps up
panels.description: Green: the verifier is fewer than 5 blocks behind the sequencer. Red: it has fallen behind. If red, open Details: L2. The two heads are scraped a moment apart, so the verifier can look one block ahead; that reads as 0.

panels.title: Proposals are made
panels.description: Green: the proposer posted a state to the L1 less than 15 minutes ago; it does about every 6. Red: older. If red, open Details: proposer and funds.

panels.title: L1 finalizes
panels.description: Green: the L1 finalized block is fewer than 160 blocks (5 epochs) behind its head; normally about 64 to 96. Red: finality has stalled. If red, open Details: L1.

panels.title: Operators have funds
panels.description: Green: the batcher and the proposer each hold at least 1 ETH on the L1. Red: one of them is running out; run make l2-fund.

panels.title: Vault holds what it owes
panels.description: Green: the vault holds at least the ETH its deposits account for, compared to the wei. Red: it holds less. If red, see the runbook VaultInsolvent.

panels.title: Vault queue is empty
panels.description: Green: no large withdrawal waits in the queue. Red: one or more do, and each must be checked against the ledger before its release block. If red, see the runbook VaultWithdrawalQueued.

panels.title: Vault is open
panels.description: Green: deposits and payments run. Red: the guardian has paused the vault. If red, see the runbook VaultPaused.

panels.title: Vault is watched
panels.description: Green: the vault exporter read the chain in the last minute. Red: it did not, and the other vault tiles show an old reading. If red, see the runbook VaultWatchStale.

panels.title: Deposits are indexed
panels.description: Green: the deposit indexer completed a step in the last minute. Red: it did not, and no deposit is held, credited or voided. If red, see the runbook DepositIndexerStale.

panels.title: Indexer keeps up
panels.description: Green: the indexer has read the chain to within 30 blocks (a minute) of the node's head. Red: it is behind, and new deposits are not yet held. If red, see the runbook DepositIndexerBehind.

panels.title: Finality holds
panels.description: Green: every block the indexer holds final is still in the chain. Red: one is not; deposits were credited on a chain that is gone and the indexer has stopped. If red, see the runbook DepositFinalityViolation.

panels.title: Ledger balances
panels.description: Green: every balance in the ledger equals the sum of its transfers, and all debits equal all credits. Red: they do not. If red, see the runbook LedgerOutOfBalance.

panels.title: L2 heads
panels.description: Unsafe: built by the sequencer. Safe: derived from batches on the L1. Finalized: its batch is in a finalized L1 block. One line per node and level.

panels.title: Blocks behind the unsafe head
panels.description: How far safe and finalized trail unsafe, per node. Safe trails by about one batch (15 blocks); finalized by L1 finality (about 300 blocks).

panels.title: Op-node peers
panels.description: Peer-to-peer connections of each op-node. Each should have the other one.

panels.title: L1 heads
panels.description: geth's head, safe and finalized blocks.

panels.title: Validator duties
panels.description: Blocks and attestations signed by the 64 validators, per minute.

panels.title: Blocks waiting to be batched
panels.description: L2 blocks the batcher holds, by stage. A queue that only grows means batches are not leaving.

panels.title: Batch transactions and blob fee
panels.description: Confirmed batcher transactions per minute, and the L1 blob base fee they paid.

panels.title: Age of the proposed state
panels.description: Seconds between now and the L2 time of the last proposed state.

panels.title: Operator balances on the L1
panels.description: ETH left to pay for batches and proposals. Topped up by make l2-fund.

panels.title: Gas used per L2 block
panels.description: Gas used by the head block of each op-reth.

panels.title: Problems
panels.description: Things that should stay at zero: op-node derivation errors and op-reth reorgs over the last 15 minutes.

panels.title: Vault ETH: held and owed
panels.description: What the vault holds and what its deposits account for, in ETH. Held is never below owed.

panels.title: Vault queue
panels.description: Withdrawals waiting in the queue, and the ETH they hold.

panels.title: Deposit indexer: blocks
panels.description: The node's head and finalized block, and the highest block the indexer has read. Deposits above finalized are held; at or below it they are credited.

panels.title: Deposits
panels.description: Deposits held now, and deposits seen, credited and voided per 10 minutes.
